page0.text:
Saber can take care of Caster.
There's no Servant left that Saber can't defeat, and Saber should be good against Caster.
Her strong Magic Resistance should make her a good choice against Caster, who is a mage.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page0:1

page1.text:
"Saber. Can you go?"
"Yes. I should go alone if we only face Caster.
You have made the right choice."
"Okay. We'll try to hold down the fort. You just need to focus on defeating Caster."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page1:1

page2.text:
A strange sound reaches me just as I finish speaking.
Is it...the sound of Saber tearing through Caster's familiars now that she's jumped out into the hall?
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page2:1

page3.text: "I'm hearing more of them now. Twenty...thirty...forty... They may be weak, but there's too many of them."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page3:1

page4.text: "Shouldn't be a problem. Dragon Tooth Warriors are imitations. They don't stand a chance against Saber. She's the incarnation of a dragon. Even a hundred of them wouldn't be a match for her."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page4:1

page5.text:
The sounds retreat into the distance.
The horde I felt surrounding the house is gone. I assume Saber defeated them all.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page5:1

page6.text:
"..."
Like Illya said, Caster's familiars can't stop Saber.
They must not have made it in here because they couldn't get past Saber.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page6:1

page7.text:
"As expected...Saber found Caster.
Caster's trying to recall all her familiars, but this looks like the end for her."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page7:1

page8.text:
If Illya's right, the battle should be over soon.
Saber won't lose in single combat.
She shouldn't have any trouble cutting Caster down since she doesn't have to worry about protecting us.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page8:1

page9.text:
"Why so glum? You look troubled, even though we're saying the fight's just about over."
"I could say the same, Tohsaka. Why does it look like something's bothering you?"
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page9:1

page10.text:
"Yeah...it just seems like things are going TOO well.
Caster knows Saber is way more powerful, so...why just launch herself at us like this?"
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page10:1

page11.text:
"..."
She's right.
Caster came here willingly.
If she knows that there's a Master here, she should already know which Servant is here too.
So she knows that Saber is here, and that Saber is a bad matchup for her.
...If she knew that and still attacked, that means—
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page11:1

page12.text:
"I don't hear anything. Illya, do you sense Caster's presence?"
"It's gone. The familiars are still around, but the only Servant left is Saber."
"There are still familiars left...?
Look...! Shirou, your arm!"
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page12:1

page13.text:
"Huh?"
I look down at my left arm.
I...don't understand what happened.
My Command Spells, proof of my contract with Saber, are gone.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page13:1

page14.text:
"Shirou, did you use a Command Spell!?"
"No. I didn't."
"..."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page14:1

page15.text:
What's going on?
Saber should've defeated Caster easily.
So then why did my Command Spell disappear?
No, my Command Spell disappearing doesn't mean my contract is severed. I shouldn't be panicking.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page15:1

page16.text:
Command Spells are there to control Servants who may act against their Master's orders.
I haven't needed to use them for Saber.
So even if I lose the Command Spells, Saber and I should be able to get along fine.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page16:1

page17.text:
"Saber's back. She'll be here soon."
"..."
What are those two doing?
Saber's just coming back, so why do they seem so worried?
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page17:1

page18.text:
The door opens.
Saber comes in.
"Hngh...guh...!"
Saber's gripping her chest. She seems to be in pain.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page18:1

page19.text:
"Saber!!!"
I rush to her.
"No! Wait, Shirou!"
I don't hear Tohsaka's warning.
All I see is that Saber is injured.
"Are you okay, Saber? Where did you—"
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page19:1

page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page20:1

page21.text:
In a single stroke, my body is cut in half, from the shoulder to the waist.
So quick is the slash that for a moment, I don't even feel pain. My mysterious healing abilities don't seem to work against the attack from Saber's sword.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page21:1

page22.text:
"...Sa...ber..."
The world starts to go dark.
As I die...
...more than my fear of death, I find myself wondering why Saber attacked me.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-01:page22:1
